name: 寄生虫 帕拉赛德
desc: 反转：这张卡表面向上混进对方卡组洗切。对方抽到这张卡时，这张卡在对方场上表侧守备表示特殊召唤，给与对方基本分1000分伤害。那之后，只要这张卡在场上表侧表示存在，对方场上表侧表示存在的怪兽全部变成昆虫族。
ruling: If “Parasite Paracide” is flipped and then destroyed as a result of battle, it does not go into the opponent’s deck.
qas:
Q: If a face up “Parasite Paracide” is drawn while the player has a full Monster field, what happens to the “Parasite Paracide”?
A: It is destroyed because there is no room on the field. bishop 02/23/2004
